values.note: Booked online through Let's Camp. Check-in 2-8 pm (later arrivals sign in at the office door), check-out 11 am; late check-out C$30. One camping unit per site. Generators 9 am-8 pm. A refund needs 3 nights' notice, less C$9.

note: About 5.6 km east of the Waterton Lakes National Park gate, at Hwy 5 and Range Rd 292, with the creek winding through the grounds. RV sites are 30-amp or 50-amp, some with water only: book the matching type. Tent sites 100-128 are mostly park-and-walk-in. Cook-shack. Outside firewood is not allowed. --Claude
summary: Keep. The operator's Let's Camp page confirms 30/50-amp sites with water and sewer, rigs to 50 ft, store, laundry, showers, wifi, dump, a C$9 booking fee and a standing 2-night minimum. The stored C$30-50 was the TENT-site table and is cleared; RV rates are unread until bookings reopen. Season not stated off-season.
